title: Parents Today Need a Lot of Help — Survey
paragraphs: Raising children has never been easy. But according to several recent surveys, many parents in the US today feel that they need much more help and support.

One survey by ZERO TO THREE, an organization that focuses on babies and young children, asked 2,202 parents of children aged five and under about their needs. It was carried out between July 28 and August 15, 2026. The survey found that 66% of parents agreed that the government should do a better job of providing resources to support families with young children.

Parents also named several specific needs. About 63% said they need free pre-kindergarten education for all children. In addition, 60% said they need clearer information about government and community programs that their families might be able to use.

Other surveys show that many parents are under a lot of pressure. A survey by the Kids Mental Health Foundation found that 97% of parents had experienced stress related to parenting in the past month. Meanwhile, a survey of 1,000 parents by Capita and YouGov in February 2026 found that half had felt down, depressed or hopeless in the previous two weeks.

Parents are also worried about their children's mental health. According to a survey of 1,386 parents by the online therapy company Grow Therapy, 80% of parents now say their child is affected by at least one source of stress, up from 64% the year before.

At the same time, many parents find it hard to ask for help. In the Grow Therapy survey, the share of parents who said they felt judged for seeking help more than doubled compared with the year before. Another survey, by Talker Research, found that parents seek help for their own concerns only 44% of the time.
These surveys were carried out by different organizations with different questions. But together, they suggest that many parents today feel stretched and would welcome more support.
